newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania livestock numbers rise in year to Sept.
newsitem.headline: Romania livestock numbers rise in year to Sept.

text.p: Romania's cattle and pig numbers rose in the year to end-September on the back of increased numbers in the private sector, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Wednesday.
The CNS said cattle numbers had risen by 25,700 to 3.87 million at the end of last month, while pig numbers had gone up by 504,600 to 10.58 million.
But the number of sheep and goats had fallen to 11.9 million at end-September -- a drop of 600,000 from the same month last year -- due to declines in both the private and state sectors.
Data showed the private sector held 91.2 percent of cattle, 64.4 percent of pigs and 93.4 percent of sheep and goats. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
